description: Search Drawcall workflows and APIs for apps, games and assets. Discover asset sourcing as well as runtime libraries. Source visual content from @drawcall/market first. When its candidates do not fit, consult @drawcall/generate for generation options and prerequisites before settling on a fallback. Reserve hand-authored geometry for gameplay structure or explicitly procedural content. @drawcall/rig adds skeletons and skin weights when needed. This searches documentation, not Market inventory: read the guides to find and inspect actual assets. Search covers all supported packages automatically, including in an empty project. Returns up to five paths with excerpts; read_skills provides the full workflows and APIs.

query.description: What you want to implement or learn how to do

name: search_skills

packages.description: Every selected package, in selection order

status.description: ready: indexed and available. indexing: not indexed yet, search again shortly. failed: could not be indexed (see error). not_allowed: this service does not index the package.

version.description: The exact version searched; null if none was found

results.description: The five best, best first, at most one per document. Empty until every selected package is ready.

excerpt.description: Relevant guide text or a declaration from the public API and its supporting types

path.description: Where the full text is: a path of the tree returned by this service

uses.description: Declaration source paths relevant to the matched guide passage

title: Search Drawcall guides and APIs
